- Primary outcome: personalization content (text responses) or ranking/scoring?
- Estimated average request size (tokens) and typical sequence length (short prompts vs context-rich)?
- Expected concurrent requests during peak (you mentioned 50–100 qps — is that per-region or total across all regions?)
- Timeline: when do you want to start the pilot ramp (you noted Feb -> Apr — is Feb 1 the target?)
- Security: do you require VPC/private deployment or is hosted OK for the pilot?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2028-01-10 11:00–11:25
- Wed 2028-01-11 15:00–15:25
- Fri 2028-01-13 09:30–09:55

If none of those work, send two windows that do and we'll match over calendar. I'll loop in Ben (SDR) to handle the scheduling and Monica (AE) for viability so the right technical folks are on.

Thanks Naomi — helpful list. Answers inline:

- Average request: ~350 tokens (prompt + candidate metadata), with worst-case 800 tokens for extended context.
- Peak concurrency: 80 qps total, concentrated in US-east; occasional bursts up to 120 qps for flash sales (~5–10 minutes).
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target is 2028-02-06 (internal deadline to start ingesting results).
- Security: hosted API is fine for the pilot; we'll evaluate Private (VPC) if production goes ahead.

Any chance we can do Wed 1/11 at 15:00 PST — that works for our ops lead (Sam). If you need a different window, we can slide.

Also attached a short traffic sample and our priority KPI definitions.
